name: False Hope
overview: Scripture teaches that hope must be anchored in the unseen promises of God rather than in visible or deferred desires, which can cause the heart to grow sick (Proverbs 13:12; Romans 8:24). True Christian hope is patient and steadfast in trials, grounded in faith as the assurance of things not seen (Romans 12:12; Hebrews 11:1). Believers are warned against false hopes built on vain words that lead to disobedience and God's wrath (Ephesians 5:6), and are instead called to hold fast to the hope reserved for them in heaven, revealed through the gospel (Colossians 1:5).
